Data Engineering Trainee - Databricks
Location: Chennai (Hybrid)

About the Role
We are hiring a Data Engineering Trainee to join our analytics platform team. You will learn to build
and maintain data pipelines on Databricks.

Requirements
- Strong knowledge of SQL or MySQL
- Proficiency in Python
- Understanding of data engineering concepts such as ETL/ELT and data pipelines

Good to have
- Exposure to PySpark / Spark and Databricks
- Cloud basics (AWS, Azure or GCP)
- Spark experience is not mandatory; training will be provided

What we value
- Problem-solving, communication, adaptability and willingness to learn

Eligibility
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related field
- Freshers welcome. No prior experience required.
